source.publication: 2025 PIT-RES Resident Individual Income Tax Return Instructions and Form PIT-RES 2025; tax rate schedule from 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14)
source.section: Form PIT-RES Lines 1-12, 20a-24, 26-27b, 32-33; Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1; PDF p.8 Line 20a standard deduction table, Line 24, Line 27a; PDF p.9 Line 27b; tax rate schedule 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14) (record brackets cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 10,250.00 = 10,250.00. Federal taxable income = 10,250.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form PIT-RES (filing status 1 single, Column B): Line 1 federal AGI 10,250.00; Line 2 other states' obligations interest 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 total 10,250.00. Line 5 U.S. obligations interest 0.00. Line 6 pension exclusion 0.00. Line 7 0.00; Line 8a 0.00; Line 8b 0.00. Line 9 (Lines 5-8b) = 0.00. Line 10 = 10,250.00 - 0.00 = 10,250.00. Line 11 0.00 (Line 11 worksheet: earned income is 2,500 or more, so no (wages 10,250.00); Line 10 is also over 10,000.00). Line 12 Delaware AGI = 10,250.00. Line 20a standard deduction (filing status 1) 3,250.00; Line 21 additional standard deduction 0 box(es) for 65 or over x 2,500.00 = 0.00; Line 22 = 3,250.00. Line 23 taxable income = 10,250.00 - 3,250.00 = 7,000.00. Line 24 tax, §1102(a)(14) schedule as numbers: 2.2% x 3,000.00 = 66.00 + 3.9% x 2,000.00 = 78.00; total 144.00 (the Division's tax table, not in the sources, would give a row figure; expected keeps the formula). Line 25 0.00; Line 26 = 144.00. Line 27a personal credits 1 x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 27b additional credits 1 box(es) for 60 or over x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 32 total non-refundable credits 220.00. Line 33 balance = 144.00 - 220.00, below zero, so 0.00 (credits are non-refundable: 144.00 of the 220.00 is used; expected credits shows the amount used). The 110 personal credit (Line 27a) is used in full; only 34.00 of the 110 additional credit (Line 27b) has tax to absorb.
